{{recipesummary|category=Taiwanese recipes|servings=3|time=Preparation: 30 minutes</br>Simmering: 1 hour|difficulty=1}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisines|Cuisines]] | [[Cookbook:East Asian cuisines|East Asian cuisines]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine_of_Taiwan|Cuisine of Taiwan]]

==Ingredients==
*6 chicken [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*4 cups water
*3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] Jasmine green [[Cookbook:Tea Leaves|tea leaves]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] dark [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]] [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] minced [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]

==Procedure==
#Bring water and spices to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
#Add eggs, and boil for 3 minutes.
#Remove eggs from the liquid and roll them gently on a hard surface to crack the shell all over.
#Return the eggs to the pot of liquid, reduce to a [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]], and simmer for 1 hour.
#Reduce to low heat and allow eggs to sit in brine until served.
